name: euaiact_classify_system
description: Classify an AI system's risk level under the EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689). Accepts a free-text description, a use_case, and/or structured signals (domain, biometric flags, synthetic content, etc.). Signals take precedence over text matching for deterministic classification. Returns risk classification, applicable Annex III category, relevant articles, provider/deployer determination, matched signals, and follow-up questions the agent should relay. Note: Art. 6(3) exceptions require documented justification and cannot be auto-applied; use euaiact_assess_art6_3_exception.

description.description: Free-text description of the AI system and its functionalities

use_case.description: Specific context where the system is deployed

domain.description: Primary sector where the system operates

uses_biometrics.description: System processes biometric data (face, fingerprint, iris, voice, gait)

biometric_sole_purpose_verification.description: Biometric use is solely to verify that a specific natural person is the person they claim to be, which is excluded from Annex III(1)(a)

biometric_remote_identification.description: System performs remote biometric identification, not merely one-to-one biometric verification

biometric_realtime.description: Biometric processing happens in real time

biometric_law_enforcement.description: Biometric system is used by or for law enforcement

biometric_publicly_accessible_space.description: Real-time remote biometric identification takes place in publicly accessible spaces (Art. 5(1)(h))

is_safety_component_of_regulated_product.description: System is a safety component of a product covered by EU harmonisation legislation (Annex I)

requires_third_party_conformity_assessme.description: The product or AI system is required to undergo third-party conformity assessment under the applicable Annex I legislation

affects_fundamental_rights.description: System materially affects health, safety, or fundamental rights of natural persons

targets_children_or_vulnerable.description: System is directed at or materially affects children or other vulnerable groups (Art. 5(1)(b))

generates_synthetic_content.description: System generates or manipulates images, audio, video, or text (Art. 50(2)/(4))

interacts_with_natural_persons.description: System is designed to interact directly with natural persons (Art. 50(1))

performs_emotion_recognition_workplace_o.description: System infers emotions of natural persons in the workplace or educational institutions (Art. 5(1)(f))

performs_social_scoring.description: System evaluates or classifies natural persons or groups over time based on social behaviour or personal/personality characteristics, leading to detrimental treatment (Art. 5(1)(c))

social_scoring_unrelated_context.description: Social scoring leads to detrimental or unfavourable treatment in social contexts unrelated to the contexts in which the data was originally generated or collected (Art. 5(1)(c)(i))

social_scoring_unjustified_or_disproport.description: Social scoring leads to detrimental or unfavourable treatment that is unjustified or disproportionate to the social behaviour or its gravity (Art. 5(1)(c)(ii))

performs_social_scoring_by_public_author.description: Legacy alias: public-authority social scoring. Art. 5(1)(c) is not limited to public authorities.
